qe: Who proposed the comprehensive 'Five Kingdom Classification' system in 1969?
qh: 1969 में जीवों के 'पाँच जगत वर्गीकरण' (Five Kingdom Classification) का प्रतिपादन किसने किया था?
e: Concept: 1969 me R.H. Whittaker ne jeevon ko paanch raajya (kingdom) me baanta - Monera (bacteria), Protista (ek-koshikiya), Fungi (kavak), Plantae (paudhe) aur Animalia (janwar); isse pehle ke system (do kingdom wala) me bacteria aur fungi ko galat jagah rakha gaya tha, isliye ye paanch raajya ka system jyada vaigyanik maana gaya. Baaki teen alag scientists hain: Linnaeus (do raajya - Plantae/Animalia, binomial nomenclature), Carl Woese (teen domain ka system), Ernst Haeckel (teen raajya). Exam point: 'Five Kingdom Classification (1969) = R.H. Whittaker'.

qe: Which biological kingdom exclusively encompasses all unicellular prokaryotic organisms like Bacteria and Cyanobacteria?
qh: किस जगत के अंतर्गत सभी प्रोकैरियोटिक एककोशिकीय जीव जैसे जीवाणु और नील-हरित शैवाल आते हैं?
e: Concept: Jeevon ki classification me sabse purana aur aasaan jeev group Monera hai - isme sirf prokaryotic (bina nucleus wale, ek-koshikiya) jeev aate hain: true bacteria (like E. coli) aur cyanobacteria (blue-green algae neela dagla shaiwal); ye saare jeev DNA ko nucleus me bina ghere rakhte hain (nucleoid) aur bare aatm-vriddhi (binary fission) se badhte hain. Baaki teen kingdoms me nucleus wale jeev hote hain: Protista (ek-koshikiya eukaryotic), Plantae (paudhe), Fungi (kavak). Exam point: 'Prokaryotic ek-koshikiya jeev (bacteria + cyanobacteria) = Kingdom Monera'.

qe: Archaebacteria capable of thriving in environments with extreme saline concentrations are termed:
qh: अत्यधिक लवणीय (खारे) क्षेत्रों में जीवित रहने वाले आद्य-जीवाणु (Archaebacteria) क्या कहलाते हैं?
e: Concept: Archaebacteria (sabse purane bacteria) aise khatarnak jagah me bhi zinda reh sakte hain jahan koi aur nahi - inhe usi hisaab se naam milte hain: bahut zyada namak (khari) wale paani me rehne wale Halophiles (jaise Dead Sea me), dhime-dhaan/garam jharnon me Thermoacidophiles, aur dal-dal (anaerobic daldal) me methane banane wale Methanogens. Baaki teen naam galat/doosre group ke hain: Methanogens, Heliophytes (khaas roshni me ugne wale paudhe), Thermoacidophiles. Exam point: 'Khari/namak wale extreme bacteria = Halophiles (extreme environment me rehne wale archaebacteria)'.

qe: Which mixotrophic flagellate organism is regarded as the 'Connecting Link' between plants and animals?
qh: पादप और जंतु जगत के बीच की 'संयोजी कड़ी' (Connecting Link) किस जीव को माना जाता है?
e: Concept: Euglena ek ek-koshikiya flagellate hai jo dono duniya ka jeev hai: isme khaas hari rangkeela (chlorophyll) hota hai isliye dhoop me apna khana khud banata hai (autotrophic, plant jaisa) - par andhere me ya dusre tarike se bahar ka khaana bhi le leta hai (heterotrophic, animal jaisa); isi wajah se ye 'mixotrophic' hai aur paudha-janwar ke beech ka jod (connecting link) kehlata hai. Baaki teen shuddh eukaryotic jeev hain: Trypanosoma (neend ki bimari), Paramecium (chappal jaisa), Amoeba (badalti aakar). Exam point: 'Paudhe-janwar ka connecting link = Euglena (mixotrophic, chlorophyll + khaana dono)'.

qe: The rigid structural cell wall of true Fungi is primarily composed of which nitrogenous polysaccharide?
qh: कवकों (Fungi) की कोशिका भित्ति मुख्य रूप से किस जटिल पॉलीसैकराइड से बनी होती है?
e: Concept: Fungi (kavak, mushroom) ki cell wall paudhon jaisi nahi hoti - ismein cellulose ki jagah ek nitrogen-yukt (nitrogen wala) polysaccharide hota hai: Chitin (wahi padarth jisse kire-makode ka bahari dhaancha banta hai); isi wajah se fungi kathor hote hain aur paudhe se alag group maane jate hain. Baaki teen alag polymers hain: Peptidoglycan (bacteria ki wall), Pectin (paudhon ke fal me), Cellulose (paudhon ki wall). Exam point: 'Fungi ki cell wall = Chitin (nitrogenous polysaccharide; bacteria ki = peptidoglycan, paudhon ki = cellulose)'.

qe: Which ciliated freshwater protozoan is commonly nicknamed the 'Slipper Animalcule' due to its asymmetric shape?
qh: चप्पल के आकार का दिखने वाला कौन सा सिलियायुक्त प्रोटोजोआ 'स्लिपर एनीमलक्यूल' कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Paramecium ek ek-koshikiya mithas-paani (freshwater) protozoan hai jo chappal (slipper) jaise aakar ka hota hai - isliye ise 'slipper animalcule' kaha jata hai; ye poore sharir par laghuk riyaiyan (cilia) se tairta aur khana (bacteria) apne munh (gullet) me dhakelta hai (aur usme contractile vacuole se paani ka santulan hota hai). Baaki teen alag protozoans hain: Plasmodium (malaria), Amoeba (badalti aakar), Euglena (flagellate). Exam point: 'Slipper animalcule (ciliated protozoan) = Paramecium'.

qe: The mutualistic composite symbiotic association between photosynthetic Algae (phycobiont) and Fungi (mycobiont) is a:
qh: शैवाल और कवक के बीच सहजीवी संबंध से बनने वाला 'लाइकेन' (Lichen) किसका संवेदनशील सूचक है?
e: Concept: Lichen ek 'sahyog' (mutualistic symbiotic association) hai jisme do alag jeev ek saath ek hi sharir banate hain: ek saathi alga (phycobiont - photosynthetic, khana banata hai) aur doosra fungus (mycobiont - paani/mineral aur jul jala deta hai, dhaancha deta hai); ye aise patthar/patton par bhi ugta hai jahan koi aur nahi ug sakta - isliye ye pradushan (pollution) ka indicator bhi hai. Baaki teen alag concepts hain: Epiphyte (paudhe par ugne wala paudha), Mycorrhiza (fungus + paudhe ki jad), Bacteriophage (bacteria ko marne wala virus). Exam point: 'Alga + fungus ka sahyog = Lichen (pollution indicator)'.

qe: Multicellular sessile organisms possessing an internal canal system with ostia and osculum belong to Phylum:
qh: छिद्रयुक्त शरीर और जल नाल तंत्र वाले स्पंज किस संघ (Phylum) के अंतर्गत आते हैं?
e: Concept: Porifera (sponges) sabse saral bahukoshikiya janwar hain: ye paani me chipke sthir (sessile) rehte hain aur unke sharir me chhote-chhote chhed (ostia) hote hain, jisse paani andar aata hai - andar ek nali (canal system) me ghoom kar khana chhanta hai aur ye paani ek bade chhed (osculum) se bahar nikal jata hai; unke sharir me khaas 'choikocytes' cells hote hain jo paani ka bahav chalate hain. Baaki teen phylum me aise ostia/osculum nahi hote: Annelida (kiri), Mollusca (ghongha), Coelenterata (jellyfish). Exam point: 'Ostia + osculum wala canal system = Phylum Porifera (sponges)'.

qe: Which colonial siphonophore hydrozoan is commonly known as the 'Portuguese Man-of-War'?
qh: 'पुर्तगाली युद्धपोत' (Portuguese Man-of-War) के नाम से किस जहरीले समुद्री जीव को जाना जाता है?
e: Concept: Physalia (Portuguese Man-of-War) ek khaas colonial hydrozoan hai jo ek hi jeev nahi balki kai 'zooids' (chhote-chhote jeevon ka jhund) se bana hota hai - kuch zooids tairne ke liye gas se bhari thaili (float) banate hain, kuch khana pakadte hain aur kuch prajanan karte hain; iske dhamsak wale tentacles ko chhoone par bahut dard aur jalan hoti hai (isliye samudra me savdhani). Baaki teen ab alag hydrozoans hain/jellyfish: Adamsia (samudri anemone), Hydra (mithas paani), Aurelia (jellyfish). Exam point: 'Portuguese Man-of-War = Physalia (colonial hydrozoan)'.

qe: Specialized ciliated 'Flame Cells' (Protonephridia) function as excretory and osmoregulatory organs in:
qh: ज्वाला कोशिकाएं (Flame Cells) किस प्राणी संघ का मुख्य उत्सर्जी और परासरण नियंत्रक अंग हैं?
e: Concept: Flatworms (Platyhelminthes) me asli kidney nahi hoti - unke sharir me ek jaal jaisa system hota hai jisme 'flame cells' (protonephridia) lage hote hain; in cells ke andar cilium ka jhunjhun (aag ki lau jaisa) chalta rehta hai jo waste (ammonia) aur zyada paani ko bahar nikalne me madad karta hai (osmoregulation + excretion dono). Baaki teen phylum me alag excretory organs hote hain: Annelida/Nephridia, Nematoda (faa wale - alag), Arthropoda (malpighian tubules). Exam point: 'Flame cells/Protonephridia (excretion + osmoregulation) = Platyhelminthes (flatworms)'.

qe: Which phylum represents the largest taxonomic phylum in Kingdom Animalia, encompassing over 80% of all animal species?
qh: जंतु जगत का सबसे बड़ा संघ (Phylum) कौन सा है जिसमें कीट, मकड़ी और केकड़े आते हैं?
e: Concept: Jeev-jantuon (Animalia) ka sabse bada phylum Arthropoda hai - ismein kire-makode, jhinge, kekde, makdi, scorpion sab aate hain, aur ye duniya ki jeev-prjaatiyon ka 80% se zyada hissa hai; inki khaas pehchaan: jode wale pair (jointed legs), chitin ka bahari dhaancha (exoskeleton) aur sharir ke teen hisse (khaas kar insekten me). Baaki teen phylum chhote hain: Echinodermata (tara machhli), Mollusca, Chordata. Exam point: 'Sabse bada phylum (80%+ species) = Arthropoda'.

qe: Insects execute direct respiration by exchanging atmospheric gases through lateral segmental pores called:
qh: कीटों के शरीर के किनारों पर स्थित वे सूक्ष्म छिद्र क्या कहलाते हैं जिनसे वे श्वास लेते हैं?
e: Concept: Insects ka saans lene ka system khaas hai: unke sharir ke dono taraf har segment me chhote chhed (pores) hote hain jinhe Spiracles kehte hain; in chhedon se hawa chitin ki patli naliyan (tracheal system) me jaati hai jo seedha har cell tak oxygen pahunchati hai (isliye unke khoon ko oxygen dhaana nahi padta). Baaki teen alag organs hain: Nephridiopores (excretion), Book lungs (spiders), Ctenidia (gills). Exam point: 'Insect ke saans ke chhed (lateral pores) = Spiracles (tracheal system ke muh)'.

qe: Which marine cephalopod mollusk possesses blue-colored blood due to the copper-based respiratory pigment Hemocyanin?
qh: ताम्र-युक्त हीमोसायनिन वर्णक के कारण किस समुद्री जीव का रक्त नीले रंग का होता है?
e: Concept: Octopus ek samudri cephalopod hai jiska khoon neela hota hai - kyunki usme oxygen dhaane wala khaas prithvi-tamra (copper - Cu) wala pigment Hemocyanin hota hai (insaan me iron wala haemoglobin laal hota hai); copper wala khoon thande samudri paani me oxygen ko achhi tarah bandhta hai. Baaki teen animals me haemoglobin ya alag pigments hain: Cockroach (haemolymph), Sepia (cutttlefish - isme haemocyanin to hai par Octopus prashn ka sahi jawab hai), Earthworm (haemoglobin). Exam point: 'Neela khoon (copper pigment) = Hemocyanin, jaise Octopus me'.

qe: Radially symmetrical marine organisms possessing a spiny calcareous endoskeleton and a hydraulic water vascular system belong to:
qh: कांटेदार त्वचा और जल संवहन तंत्र (Water Vascular System) वाले समुद्री जीव जैसे तारा मछली (Starfish) किस संघ में आते हैं?
e: Concept: Echinodermata (tara machhli/starfish, samudri khoon, samudri kheera...) saare samudri janwar hain jinme do khaas pehchaan hoti hain: (1) unka dhaancha safed chamakdar kalk dhari (calcareous) spines ka banta hai (isi wajah se naam 'kant wali chamdi') aur (2) unke sharir me ek 'water vascular system' hota hai - naliyon ka jaal jisme paani bhara hota hai aur jisse wo chhote 'tube feet' ko chala kar chalta hai, khana pakadta hai. Baaki teen phylum alag hain: Arthropoda, Hemichordata, Mollusca. Exam point: 'Spiny calcareous skeleton + water vascular system = Echinodermata'.

qe: The formalized taxonomic system of Binomial Nomenclature (Genus and Species) was established by:
qh: द्विपद नामकरण पद्धति (Binomial Nomenclature) का प्रतिपादन किस वैज्ञानिक ने किया था?
e: Concept: Do-naam wali (binomial) padhti - jaise Homo sapiens, Pavo cristatus - ki shuruaat Carolus Linnaeus ne ki: har jeev ka ek do-shabd naam hota hai (pehla Genus - bada akshar, doosra Species - chhota akshar) aur ye Latin bhasha me likha jata hai; isse duniya bhar me ek hi jeev ko ek hi naam se jana jata hai. Baaki teen alag scientists hain: Lamarck (evolution theory), Theophrastus (botany ke janak), Darwin (natural selection). Exam point: 'Binomial nomenclature ke janak = Carolus Linnaeus'.

qe: African Trypanosomiasis (Sleeping Sickness) is caused by Trypanosoma protozoa transmitted by:
qh: अफ्रीकी निद्रा रोग (Sleeping Sickness) किस प्रोटोजोआ द्वारा होता है और किस मक्खी से फैलता है?
e: Concept: African Trypanosomiasis - neend ki bimari (Sleeping Sickness) - Trypanosoma brucei naam ke ek flagellate protozoan se hoti hai aur ye Tsetse fly (Glossina) ke kaatne se insaan me failti hai; isse bukhar, kamzori aur badhne par din me hi sona (neend ki bimari) hota hai. Baaki teen options me bimari-keet ka joda galat hai: Plasmodium (malaria) Anopheles se, Entamoeba (pechish) ghar ki makkhi se nahi, Leishmania sandfly se (ye alag bimari kala-azar). Exam point: 'Neend ki bimari (Sleeping sickness) = Trypanosoma brucei + Tsetse fly (Glossina)'.

qe: Which division of seedless vascular cryptogamic plants is colloquially dubbed the 'Snakes of the Plant Kingdom'?
qh: संवहनी ऊतक (Xylem/Phloem) रखने वाले प्रथम स्थलीय पौधे फर्न किस समूह में आते हैं जिन्हें 'पादप जगत का सरीसृप' कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Pteridophytes (fern) wo paudhe hain jo beej nahi banate (cryptogams - chhupe prajanan) par unme paani jane wali naliyan (vascular tissue) hoti hain; inke patte lambe, sujhne wale hote hain aur unke tane/cire (rhizome) zameen me rhengte hue saanp jaisi dikhte hain - isliye inhe 'Snakes of the Plant Kingdom' kaha jata hai. Baaki teen divisions alag hain: Thallophytes (sabse saral), Gymnosperms (nange beej), Bryophytes (moss). Exam point: 'Snakes of plant kingdom (beej-bina vascular plants) = Pteridophytes (fern)'.

qe: Non-flowering seed plants bearing ovules that are completely naked and not enclosed within a protective ovary wall are:
qh: अनावृतबीजी पौधे (जैसे चीड़ और साइकस) जिनके बीज फल के अंदर बंद नहीं होते, क्या कहलाते हैं?
e: Concept: Gymnosperms (jaise Deodar, Pine, Cycas) aise paudhe hain jinme beej (ovule) khule me hote hain - unke aas-paas phal (fruit) ki deewar (ovary wall) nahi hoti, isliye 'nange beej' (gymnos = nanga, sperma = beej) kehlate hain; inke beej usually shanku (cone) me bante hain aur hawa se parag (pollination) hota hai (samudri amaltas). Baaki teen alag groups hain: Pteridophytes (beej nahi), Bryophytes (vasculature nahi), Angiosperms (beej phal ke andar = band beej). Exam point: 'Nange (band na kiye) beej wale paudhe = Gymnosperms'.

qe: Which avian species native to Cuba represents the smallest living bird in the world?
qh: क्यूबा में पाई जाने वाली विश्व की सबसे छोटी जीवित पक्षी प्रजाति कौन सी है?
e: Concept: Duniya ka sabse chhota jeev-pakshi Cuba ka Bee Hummingbird (Mellisuga helenae) hai - iska wazan lagbhag 1.6-2 gram aur lambai 5-6 cm hoti hai (ek choohar/keere se bhi halka), aur ye apne pankhon ko itni tez (lagbhag 80 par second) hilata hai ki hawa me khada-ek jagah 'hover' kar leta hai. Baaki teen naam asli pakshiyon ke hain par sabse chhote nahi: House Sparrow, Weebill (Australia ka sabse chhota), Spotted Pardalote. Exam point: 'Duniya ka sabse chhota pakshi = Bee Hummingbird (Cuba)'.

qe: The Gila monster (Heloderma suspectum) native to the southwestern US and northwestern Mexico is recognized as:
qh: विश्व की एकमात्र जहरीली छिपकली (Venomous Lizard) कौन सी है?
e: Concept: Gila monster (Heloderma suspectum) ek mota, dhabbe wala chhipkali (lizard) hai jo America ke registan me milta hai - ye duniya ki un do hi zehrili chhipkaliyon me se ek hai (doosri Beaded Lizard), jo kaatne par zeher chhodti hai (isliye Heloderma - 'nail skin' wale poisonous lizards); ye apne zehar ko (jo aaj diabetes ki dawa ka base bana) mashhoor hai. Baaki teen alag hain: Komodo Dragon (badi chhipkali, alag khaas), Monitor Lizard (gho), Chameleon (rang badalne wala). Exam point: 'Gila monster = Heloderma (zehrili chhipkali; America ki)'.

qe: Which geological period of the Paleozoic Era is famously known as the 'Age of Fishes' due to explosive aquatic evolution?
qh: जीवाश्म विज्ञान में किस कल्प को 'मत्स्य युग' (Age of Fishes) कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Paleozoic Era me Devonian Period (lagbhag 41.9-35.9 crore saal pehle) ko 'Age of Fishes' kehte hain kyunki isi daur me jabde wali machhliyon (jawed fishes) ka bahut tez vikas hua - aaj ki kai machhli groups (sharks, lobe-finned) isi daur ki hai; isi daur ke ant me machhliyon se zameen wale jeev (ubhaychar/amphibians) bhi banne lage. Baaki teen alag hain: Cambrian (sudden jeev-vikas), Jurassic (dinosaur), Carboniferous (koyla). Exam point: 'Age of Fishes = Devonian period (Paleozoic era)'.

qe: How many contractile chambers are present in the venous, single-circulation heart of cartilaginous and bony fishes?
qh: मछलियों के हृदय में कितने कोष्ठक (Chambers) पाए जाते हैं जो केवल अशुद्ध रक्त पंप करते हैं?
o: Two chambers (one atrium and one ventricle)
e: Concept: Machhliyon (cartilaginous + bony) ka dil 2 'kaam karne wale kapre' (chambers) se banta hai: 1 atrium (khoon lene wala) + 1 ventricle (khoon bahar bhejne wala); isme khoon ek hi chakkar (single circulation) me chalta hai - heart se gills me jaata hai, oxygen leta hai, phir seedha sharir me - aur gills se wapas heart me aata hai (isliye machhli ka heart gair-oxygen wala khoon pump karta hai). Baaki teen numbers doosre janwar ke hain: 4 (insaan), 1 (koi nahi), 3 (ubhaychar). Exam point: 'Machhli ka dil = 2 chambers (single circulation)'.

qe: Which of the following organisms represents an authentic aquatic vertebrate belonging to Superclass Pisces (True Fish)?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी वास्तव में एक 'सत्य मछली' (True Fish) है?
e: Concept: 'Pisces' (True fish) sirf un jeevon ko kehte hain jinka asli fish wala dhaancha ho - vertebral column (reer ki haddi) ho, gills se saans le, pankh (fins) se tairta ho aur paani me hi rehta ho (aquatic vertebrate). Dogfish (Scoliodon - ek chhoti shark) asli machhli hai (cartilaginous, but fish). Baaki teen ke naam me 'fish' hai par wo machhli nahi hain: Silverfish (ek keet), Starfish (echinoderm), Jellyfish (coelenterate). Exam point: 'Asli fish (Pisces) = Dogfish/Scoliodon (shark); Starfish/Jellyfish/Silverfish fish nahi hain'.

qe: The academic scientific discipline dedicated to the study of fish anatomy, taxonomy, and physiology is:
qh: मछलियों की शारीरिक संरचना और वर्गीकरण के अध्ययन को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Jeevon ke adhyayan ke alag-alag shastr unke group ke hisaab se hain: Ichthyology = machhliyon (fish) ka poora adhyayan - unka dhaancha (anatomy), vargikaran (taxonomy), physiology, vyavhar aur unki bimariyan. Machhliyan vertebrate (reer wale) jeevon ki sabse badi group hain (34,000 se zyada species), isliye inka alag shastr bana. Baaki teen alag shastr hain: Ornithology (pakshi), Herpetology (sarisrip + ubhaychar - snakes/frogs), Entomology (keet). Exam point: 'Machhliyon ka adhyayan = Ichthyology'.

qe: The Late Jurassic fossil Archaeopteryx lithographica represents an evolutionary 'Connecting Link' between:
qh: आर्कियोप्टेरिक्स (Archaeopteryx) किन दो प्राणी वर्गों के बीच की संयोजी कड़ी माना जाता है?
e: Concept: 1861 me Germany ke Bavaria me mila Archaeopteryx lithographica ek 'fossil jod' (connecting link) hai jo dikhata hai ki pakshi (Aves) sarisrip (Reptilia) se bane - uske sharir me sarisrip wale lakshan (daant, lambi haddi wali poonch, panje wali ungliyan) aur pakshi wale lakshan (pankh, khaas pidli ki haddi - furcula/forked) dono the; isliye ye evolution ka sabse mashhoor pramaan hai. Baaki teen jodiyan galat hain: birds-mammals, amphibians-reptiles, fishes-amphibians ka koi aisa jeev nahi. Exam point: 'Archaeopteryx = Reptiles aur Birds ke beech ka connecting link (fossil)'.

qe: How many heart chambers are characteristic of adult Amphibians (such as Frogs and Toads)?
qh: मेंढक जैसे उभयचरों (Amphibians) के हृदय में कितने कोष्ठक होते हैं?
o: Three chambers (two atria and one ventricle)
e: Concept: Ubhaychar (amphibians - mendhak, tadpoles) ka dil 3 chambers ka hota hai: 2 atrium (khoon lene wale - ek gair-oxygen wala khoon, ek oxygen wala) + 1 ventricle (khoon pelo); dono taraf ka khoon ventricle me mil jata hai (isliye unka body temperature bahar ke hisaab se badalta hai - cold blooded); isi '3 chambers' se unhe 'do zindagi wale' (paani + zameen) jeev maana jata hai. Baaki teen numbers doosre janwar ke hain: 13 (tilchatta), 2 (machhli), 4 (insaan/pakshi). Exam point: 'Amphibian ka dil = 3 chambers (2 atrium + 1 ventricle)'.

qe: Snakes and lizards gather airborne scent chemicals with their forked tongue and deliver them to which sensory organ on the palate?
qh: साँपों के तालू में गंध और स्वाद की पहचान करने वाला कौन सा संवेदी अंग होता है?
e: Concept: Saanp-chhipkali apna shikar sunghne ke liye apna kata hua (forked) jabaan bahar nikaal kar hawa ke rasayan (scent chemicals) chunte hain, phir jabaan ko munh ke andar lakar ek khaas sensory organ - Jacobson's Organ (vomeronasal organ) - par lagate hain, jahan se us badbu/khushbu ka signal brain tak jata hai; isse wo bina bu aake pata kar lete hain ki shikar kis taraf hai (matlab 'dekhne' jaisa kaam). Baaki teen doosre organs hain: Weberian ossicle (machhli me sunna), Ampullae of Lorenzini (shark ka electric sense), Statocyst (invertebrate ka balance organ). Exam point: 'Saanp ke jabaan se sunghne ka organ = Jacobson's organ (vomeronasal organ)'.

qe: Which crocodilian archosaur represents the sole reptilian exception by possessing a completely partitioned four-chambered heart?
qh: कौन सा सरीसृप (Reptile) एक अपवाद है और पक्षियों व स्तनधारियों की तरह 4-कक्षीय हृदय रखता है?
e: Concept: Sarisripon (reptiles) ka dil usually 3 chambers ka hota hai (kuch me thoda batav), par ek khaas apwaad hai Magarmach (Crocodile): unka dil poori tarah 4 chambers ka (2 atrium + 2 ventricle) hota hai - jaise pakshi aur stanpaayi ka; isse oxygen wala aur gair-oxygen wala khoon bilkul alag rehta hai (isliye wo lambe samay paani ke andar reh sakte hain) aur yahi unhe 'archosaur' group ka ahem sadasya banata hai (dinosaur/pakshi ki shreni). Baaki teen reptiles me aisa nahi hota: King Cobra, Sea Turtle, Monitor lizard (in sab me 3 chambers hi hote hain). Exam point: 'Sarisripon me 4-chambered dil wala apwaad = Crocodile (magarmach)'.

qe: Hollow, pneumatic bones containing continuous extensions of pulmonary air sacs are an adaptation of which vertebrate class?
qh: हवा से भरी खोखली हड्डियाँ (Pneumatic Bones) किस प्राणी वर्ग की मुख्य शारीरिक विशेषता हैं?
e: Concept: Pakshiyon (Aves) ki haddiyan khaas hoti hain - ye khaali (hollow, jise pneumatic bones kehte hain) hoti hain aur unke andar phephde ki hawa ki thailiyan (air sacs) tak jaati hain; isse unka wazan bahut kam rehta hai (udne ke liye zaroori) aur hawa ko andar-bahar bhejne me madad milti hai (double breathing - saans lene aur chhodne dono me oxygen milti hai). Baaki teen classes me aisa nahi hota: Amphibia, Mammalia, Reptilia - inki haddiyan poori/gatti (solid) hoti hain. Exam point: 'Hollow pneumatic bones + air sacs = Aves (pakshi; udne ki adaptation)'.

qe: The Duck-billed Platypus (Ornithorhynchus anatinus) and Spiny Anteater (Echidna) are unique mammals classified as:
qh: प्लेटिपस और एकिडना जैसे स्तनधारी जो बच्चे देने के बजाय अंडे देते हैं, किस समूह में आते हैं?
e: Concept: Platypus (duck-billed) aur Echidna (spiny anteater) duniya ke sabse ajeeb stanpaayi (mammals) hain - ye ande dete hain (oviparous) aur doodh pilate hain (par than nahi, chamdi ki dhaar se doodh riste hue bachche chaat lete hain), aur inka cloaca (ek hi chhed) hota hai; isliye inhe Prototheria (Monotremes) kehte hain aur ye 'reptile-mammal' ke beech ka jod maane jate hain. Baaki teen groups alag hain: Marsupials (kangaroo - than/pouch), Eutherians aur Placental (insaan, cow - poora vikas pet me). Exam point: 'Ande dene wale mammals (than ke bina doodh) = Prototheria/Monotremes (Platypus, Echidna)'.

qe: Whales and dolphins, being aquatic mammals, execute atmospheric gas exchange through which respiratory organ?
qh: व्हेल और डॉल्फिन जैसे समुद्री स्तनधारी सांस लेने के लिए किस अंग का उपयोग करते हैं?
e: Concept: Whale aur dolphin paani me rehte hain par wo machhli nahi, stanpaayi (mammals) hain - isliye unke gills nahi hote aur wo saans lene ke liye upar aate hain: unke sar ke upar blowhole (naak ke chhed) hote hain jisse wo hawa andar- bahar leti hain aur phir poore gote laga leti hain (ek saans me bahut der tak paani ke andar reh sakti hain). Baaki teen options machhli/invertebrate ke hain: External gills (machhli), Tracheal tubes (keet), Vascular skin (kuch ubhaychar/pudki saans). Exam point: 'Whale/Dolphin (mammal) = Lungs + blowhole se saans (gills nahi)'.

qe: What is the scientific taxonomic binomen of the Indian Peafowl, designated as the National Bird of India?
qh: भारत के राष्ट्रीय पक्षी मोर का वैज्ञानिक नाम क्या है?
e: Concept: Har jeev ka vaigyanik do-shabd (binomial) naam hota hai jisme pehla shabd Genus (bada akshar) aur doosra Species (chhota akshar) hota hai, aur poora naam Latin/italic me likha jata hai; Bharat ka rashtriya pakshi mor (Indian Peafowl) ka binomen Pavo cristatus hai (peacock = nar mor, peahen = madi mor). Baaki teen aam pakshiyon ke naam hain: Corvus splendens (crow/kaua), Passer domesticus (gauraiya), Columba livia (kabootar). Exam point: 'Indian Peafowl (national bird) = Pavo cristatus'.

qe: The African Ostrich (Struthio camelus) holds the biological distinction of being the:
qh: विश्व का सबसे बड़ा और सबसे भारी जीवित पक्षी कौन सा है जो उड़ नहीं सकता?
o: Largest living bird and producer of the largest single cell (egg)
e: Concept: African Ostrich (Struthio camelus) ki do badi khaas baatein hain: (1) ye zinda sabse bada pakshi hai - lambai tak 2.5 m aur wazan 100 kg+ tak, ud nahi sakta par tez (70 km/h) daudta hai; aur (2) uska andaa duniya ka sabse bada 'single cell' (ek hi koshiya) hota hai - wazan lagbhag 1.3-1.5 kg (matlab 25 murge ke andon jitna), isliye ise sabse bada cell kaha jata hai. Baaki teen galat hain: tez tairne wala pakshi (penguin), sabse chhota ud-na-pane wala (kiwi), aur ekmatra carnivorous ratite (aisa ek hi nahi hai). Exam point: 'Sabse bada jeevit pakshi + sabse bada single-cell egg = African Ostrich'.

qe: Bats (Microchiroptera) fly through absolute darkness and intercept nocturnal prey using high-frequency acoustic:
qh: चमगादड़ रात के अंधेरे में बिना टकराए उड़ने और शिकार पकड़ने के लिए किस तकनीक का उपयोग करते हैं?
e: Concept: Chamgadar (bats) raat me andhere me udti hai kyunki wo 'echolocation' (biosonar) use karti hai - apne munh ya naak se bahut unchi aavritti (high-frequency ultrasound) ki awaazein nikalta hai jo aas-paas ki cheezon se takra kar wapas aati hain; unke kaan un pratidhvaniyaan sun kar bat dete hain ki shikar ya rukavat kitni door aur kis dish me hai (matlab 'awaaz se dekhna'). Baaki teen nahi: Magnetic navigation (kuch pakshi), Infrared thermography (kuch saanp - garmi se dekhna), Bioluminescence (roshni paida karna - jugnu). Exam point: 'Chamgadar ka andhere me udna = Echolocation (ultrasound se sonar)'.

qe: The Indian Python (Python molurus) subdues and suffocates its mammalian prey through which mechanical method?
qh: भारतीय अजगर (Python) बिना जहर के अपने शिकार को किस प्रकार मारता है?
o: Constriction (coiling around the thorax to cause circulatory arrest and suffocation)
e: Concept: Ajgar (Indian Python) apne shikar ko zeher se nahi, 'jakad' (constriction) se maarta hai: ye apne jism ki guthiya (coil) se shikar ke seene ko itna zyada dabata hai ki uska saans lena band ho jata hai aur khoon ka dalna ruk jata hai (circulatory arrest) - shikar kuch hi minute me behosh ho kar mar jata hai; isliye 'ajgar bhawnch deta hai' sahi hai, wo kaatta nahi (wo non-venomous hai). Baaki teen galat hain: bahar se pickle pachane wale enzymes, bijli ke jhatke, aur zehir (ye sab doosre jeevon ke tarike hain). Exam point: 'Ajgar (Python) shikar ko = Constriction (jakad) se maarta hai (zehir nahi)'.

qe: The tobacco mosaic virus (TMV), the first virus isolated in pure crystalline form by Stanley, possesses which genetic core?
qh: तंबाकू मोज़ेक वायरस (TMV) में आनुवंशिक सामग्री के रूप में क्या पाया जाता है?
e: Concept: Virus ek aisa 'jeev-nirmaan' hai jo jeeta nahi - usme sirf ek genetic material (DNA ya RNA) aur uske chaaron taraf protein ki chaddar (capsid) hoti hai. Tobacco Mosaic Virus (TMV) sabse pehla virus hai jise 1935 me W.M. Stanley ne pure crystalline (katthar) roop me alag kiya - aur usme genetic material RNA tha, woh bhi 'single-stranded' (ek dhage wali) RNA. Baaki teen galat hain: Ye DNA nahi, circular plasmid nahi, aur double-stranded DNA nahi. Exam point: 'TMV (pehla pure crystal virus) = single-stranded RNA'.

qe: Viruses that specifically infect, replicate within, and lyse bacterial cells are clinically termed:
qh: जीवाणुओं (Bacteria) को संक्रमित करने और उन्हें नष्ट करने वाले वायरस क्या कहलाते हैं?
e: Concept: Bacteriophage (jaise T4 phage) wo virus hote hain jo khaas kar bacteria ko apna shikar (host) banate hain: ye apni poonch (tail) se bacteria ki deewar me chhed karke apna DNA andar daal dete hain, andar jaakar wo bacteria ki machinery se hazaaron naye virus banate hain aur ant me bacteria ko phaad (lyse) dete hain - isliye inhe 'bacteria ke khane wale' (bacterio + phage) kehte hain (phage therapy isi par adharit hai). Baaki teen alag hain: Retroviruses (RNA se DNA, jaise HIV), Viroids (sirf RNA, paudhon me), Prions (protein, dimag ki bimari). Exam point: 'Bacteria ko kaatne wale virus = Bacteriophage (phage)'.

qe: Plant pathogens smaller than viruses consisting solely of short, circular, naked single-stranded RNA without a protein capsid are:
qh: वायरस से भी छोटे संक्रामक कण जिनमें प्रोटीन आवरण (Capsid) नहीं होता और केवल स्वतंत्र RNA होता है:
e: Concept: Viroid virus se bhi chhota hota hai - usme protein ki chaddar (capsid) bilkul nahi hoti, sirf chhota-sa, circular, single-stranded RNA hota hai (matlab nange RNA ka tukda); ye khaas kar paudhon me bimari karte hain (jaise aalu ka spindle tuber) aur paudhe ko badhne se rok dete hain. Baaki teen alag hain: Mycoplasma (sabse chhota jeevit bacteria - cell hai), Bacteriophages (virus jisme protein coat hai), Prions (protein, RNA nahi). Exam point: 'Sirf nange RNA wala (capsid bina) sabse chhota pathogen = Viroid (paudhon me)'.

qe: Infectious self-propagating misfolded proteins lacking nucleic acids that cause Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy (Mad Cow Disease) are:
qh: बिना किसी डीएनए या आरएनए के केवल विकृत प्रोटीनों से बने संक्रामक कण क्या कहलाते हैं?
e: Concept: Prion ek 'galti se mud gaya' (misfolded) protein hota hai jisme DNA/RNA kuch nahi hota - par jab wo sahi protein ko chhoota hai, to usko bhi galat mud deta hai; is tarah ye 'chain reaction' ki tarah dimag me phailta hai aur dimag ko spongy (sankram) bana deta hai (isi wajah se Mad Cow Disease - BSE, aur insaan me CJD kahlata hai). Baaki teen alag hain: Viruses (DNA/RNA hote hain), Protozoans (ek-koshikiya jeev), Viroids (sirf RNA). Exam point: 'Bina nucleic acid wala infectious protein (Mad Cow disease) = Prion'.

qe: The Sea Horse (Hippocampus) is taxonomically classified as a specialized member of which class?
qh: समुद्री घोड़ा (Sea Horse) अपनी बनावट के बावजूद वास्तव में किस वर्ग का जीव है?
e: Concept: Sea Horse (Hippocampus) dikhta aisa hai ki lagta hai machhli nahi - uska sar ghode jaisa, poonch muri hui aur sharir haddi ki plates se dhaka hota hai; par vaigyanik taur par wo ek 'asli haddi wali machhli' (bony fish) hai: usme gills se saans, fins, swim bladder aur skeleton sab Osteichthyes (bony fishes) jaisa hota hai (aur gaur-talb ye nari hi bachche ko pet me palati hai). Baaki teen classes galat hain: Mollusca (ghongha), Amphibia, Mammalia. Exam point: 'Sea Horse (Hippocampus) = Osteichthyes (asli bony fish)'.

qe: The internal hydrostatic gas-filled organ that enables bony fishes to maintain neutral buoyancy at variable water depths is the:
qh: हड्डीदार मछलियों में पानी में तैरते रहने और डूबने से बचाने वाला वायु-कोष क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Machhli jab tairti hai to use paani me 'tairne' ke liye utni hi energy nahi lagni chahiye - iske liye bony fishes ke andar ek khaas 'gas ki thaili' hoti hai: Swim Bladder (air bladder), jisme gas (oxygen) bhar kar wo paani ke jaisa ghana (neutral buoyancy) ho jata hai - matlab bina mehnet ke kisi bhi gehrai par tair sakta hai (gehre jaane par gas nikaal, upar jaane par gas bhar). Baaki teen alag hain: Spiral valve (shark ke aant me), Operculum (gills ka dhakkan), Lateral line (paani ki lehron ka sensor). Exam point: 'Neutral buoyancy ke liye gas wali thaili = Swim bladder (air bladder)'.

qe: Which freshwater mammal declared the National Aquatic Animal of India is functional blind and relies on echolocation in the Ganga?
qh: भारत का राष्ट्रीय जलीय जीव कौन सा है जो गंगा नदी में पाया जाता है और पराश्रव्य ध्वनि पर निर्भर करता है?
e: Concept: Ganges River Dolphin (Platanista gangetica) - jise 'Susu' bhi kehte hain - Bharat ka rashtriya jal-jeev (National Aquatic Animal) hai; iski aankhon me lens nahi hoti (isliye wo practically andha hai) par wo 'echolocation' (ultrasound) se Ganga ke gande paani me shikar dhoondhta hai aur rasta chalata hai; ye khaas kar mil dolphins se alag hai (asli nadi dolphin). Baaki teen an ya alag hain: Gharial (magarmach), Dugong, Irrawaddy Dolphin (doosri nadi ki dolphin, national nahi). Exam point: 'National Aquatic Animal (Ganga me, blind + echolocation) = Ganges River Dolphin (Susu)'.

qe: Limulus polyphemus (Horseshoe Crab), which has retained its ancestral morphology for hundreds of millions of years, is an exemplar of a:
qh: करोड़ों वर्षों से बिना किसी शारीरिक बदलाव के जीवित रहने वाला हॉर्सशू क्रैब किसका उदाहरण है?
e: Concept: Kuch jeev - jaise Horseshoe Crab (Limulus polyphemus) - karodon (lagbhag 45 crore) saal se bilkul waisa hi bane hue hain, unka dhaancha aaj bhi unke purane jeevon (fossil) wale dhaancha jaisa hai; isliye aise jeevon ko 'Living Fossil' kehte hain (matlab zinda fossil - jo badla nahi). Dhyaan rakhna: ye koi machhli nahi, ek arthropod hai jiska khoon neela hota hai aur jiske khoon se khaas medical test hota hai. Baaki teen galat hain: Extinct (wo mar chuke), Endangered mollusk (ye arthropod hai), Transitional link (alag concept). Exam point: 'Karodon saal se na badalne wala jeev = Living fossil (jaise Horseshoe crab, Latimeria)'.

qe: Adult organisms of Class Insecta are morphologically defined by having segmented bodies and how many pairs of thoracic walking legs?
qh: कीट वर्ग (Class Insecta) के जंतुओं के वक्ष पर चलने के लिए कितने पैर (टाँगें) होते हैं?
e: Concept: Keet (Class Insecta) ki pehchaan: sharir 3 hisson me (sar, chest, pet) bata hua, chest par 3 jodi (6) pair (jointed legs), aksar 2 jodi pankh, aur chitin ka bahari dhaancha; yahi 6 pair usool unhe sabse bade jeev group (Arthropoda) ke doosre groups (makdi ke 8 pair, kankhajura ke kai pair) se alag karta hai. Baaki teen gintiyan doosre groups ki hain: 8 (makdi/arachnid), 10 (kekde/crustacean), 4 (kabhi nahi). Exam point: 'Insect = 3 pairs (6) thoracic legs (makdi = 4 pairs / 8 legs)'.

qe: Commercial silk fibers are harvested from the cocoon spun by the salivary fibroin secretions of which lepidopteran insect?
qh: रेशम कीट पालन (Sericulture) में रेशम के धागे किससे प्राप्त किए जाते हैं?
e: Concept: Resham (silk) khaas keeton (insects) ke larva ke andar banta hai: Bombyx mori (silkworm/resham ki keedi) ki laar (salivary gland) me ek protein taral (fibroin) banta hai; jab uska larva badi ho jati hai to ye ek lamba dhaaga bana kar apne chaaron taraf ek 'koya' (cocoon) lapet leta hai - dhaage ko insaan usi koya se nikaal (reel) kar kapda banata hai. Baaki teen keet alag kaam ke hain: Laccifer lacca (loq/lac - ek resin), Apis mellifera (shahad ki makhi), Drosophila (genetics ki khoj). Exam point: 'Resham (silk) = Bombyx mori (silkworm) ke cocoon se'.

qe: Natural pearls are biologically formed by marine bivalve pearl oysters (Pinctada) through the concentric deposition of:
qh: समुद्री सीप (Pearl Oyster) में मोती का निर्माण किस पदार्थ की परतों के जमने से होता है?
o: Nacre (Mother of Pearl - Calcium carbonate and Conchiolin)
e: Concept: Moti (natural pearl) ek 'jewel' hai jo ek jeev (sip/jhinga - bivalve mollusc, Pinctada pearl oyster) banata hai: jab uske mantel me koi chhoti bahari cheez (raet/parasite) ghus jati hai to wo uske chaaron taraf ek-khaas padarth ki parton (layers) me parat chadhaata hai jise Nacre (Mother of Pearl) kehte hain - isme calcium carbonate (aragonite) aur ek protein (conchiolin) hota hai (isi parat ke jama hone se moti ban jata hai). Baaki teen galat padarth hain: Silica gel, Chitin, Magnesium phosphate. Exam point: 'Moti = Nacre (calcium carbonate + conchiolin) ki parat se banti hai'.

qe: The rasping, chitinous, tongue-like feeding ribbon found in the buccal cavity of grazing mollusks is the:
qh: घोंघा और सीपी जैसे मोलस्का जीवों में भोजन को खुरचने वाली जीभ जैसी संरचना क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Mollusca (ghongha, sip, keet, octopus) ke munh (buccal cavity) me ek khaas tarah ki 'rasp' (parredaar) hoti hai - Radula - ek chitin ki patti jis par kai chhote-chhote daant (teeth) ki kataar lagi hoti hai; isse wo aam taur par paani ke patton/algae ko khurach kar khate hain (jaise file se ragadna). Baaki teen alag structures hain: Proboscis (kuch jeevon ki lambi naak/saana), Aristotle's lantern (samudri hedgehog/sang hai to - sea urchin ka jabda), Ctenidium (gills). Exam point: 'Mollusca ke munh me rasping ribbon (khurachne wali) = Radula'.

qe: The velvet worm Peripatus exhibits a mosaic of parapodia-like unjointed legs and tracheal tubes, representing a link between:
qh: पेरिपेटस (Peripatus) किन दो बड़े अकशेरुकी संघों के बीच की संयोजी कड़ी है?
e: Concept: Peripatus (velvet worm) ek aisa jeev hai jo Annelida aur Arthropoda ke beech ka mila-jula jaisa lagta hai: isme annelid jaisi cheezein (patli chamdi, latakti naali jaisi pair - parapodia) aur arthropod jaisi cheezein (chitin wali cuticle, trachea se saans) dono hoti hain - isliye ise dono phylum ke beech ka jod (connecting link) kaha jata hai. Baaki teen jodiyan is tarah ke mila-jule jeev nahi hain: Mollusca-Echinodermata (trochophore larva wali samanta), Chordata-Non-chordata, Platyhelminthes-Nematoda. Exam point: 'Peripatus = Annelida aur Arthropoda ke beech ka connecting link'.

qe: Periodic shedding and replacement of the rigid, non-expanding chitinous cuticular exoskeleton in growing arthropods is:
qh: कीटों द्वारा अपने शरीर के पुराने कठोर बाह्य कंकाल को उतारकर नया कंकाल बनाने की प्रक्रिया क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Arthropods ka bahari khaancha (exoskeleton - chitin ka hard coat) haddiyon ki tarah badh nahi sakta, isliye jab keedu badhta hai to uska purana coat tang pad jata hai - phir wo us purane coat ko tod/phod (shed) kar bahar nikalta hai aur naya, bada, naram coat banata hai; is process ko Ecdysis (Molting) kehte hain (is dauraan wo narm aur asurakshit hota hai). Baaki teen alag biological processes hain: Diapause (susti), Parthenogenesis (bina nari se santaan), Metamorphosis (aakar badalna - jaise keedu se titli). Exam point: 'Purana exoskeleton chhod kar naya banana = Ecdysis (molting)'.

qe: The compound eyes of arthropods produce a mosaic visual image through thousands of individual photoreceptor optical units called:
qh: कीटों की संयुक्त आँखों (Compound Eyes) में पाए जाने वाले हजारों दृष्टि संबंधी स्वतंत्र लेंस क्या कहलाते हैं?
e: Concept: Arthropods ke 'compound eyes' bade hote hain par unka image humare aankh jaisa saaf nahi hota - unmein hazaaron chhote-chhote 'optical units' (har ek me lens + photoreceptor) hote hain jinhe Ommatidia kehte hain; har ommatidium apni chhoti si 'duniya' dekh kar dimaag me ek tukda bhejti hai aur sab milkar ek 'mosaic' (tukdon wala - mosaic jaisa) image banti hai (isliye wo harkat ko jaldi bhaap lete hain, par detail kam dekhte hain). Baaki teen alag structures hain: Nephridia (excretion), Ocelli (simple eyes - chhote bindu), Statocysts (balance). Exam point: 'Compound eye ki optical units = Ommatidia (mosaic image)'.

qe: Unique respiratory 'Book Lungs' consisting of stacked, leaf-like vascular lamellae are characteristic of:
qh: किताब के पन्नों जैसे दिखने वाले 'बुक लंग्स' (Book Lungs) किस वर्ग के जीवों के श्वसन अंग हैं?
e: Concept: 'Book lungs' (kitaab ke panno jaisi pattiyan wale phaipde) un jeevon me hote hain jo zameen par rehte hain par unka purana group paani wala tha - Arachnids (makdi, scorpion): unke pet ke neeche ek khaas khaan (chamber) me pankhon jaisi patli parton (lamellae) kitaab ke panno ki tarah charhi hoti hain, aur unke beech hawa se khoon me oxygen jaati hai. Baaki teen groups ke alag saans ke organs hote hain: Myriapods (trachea - naali), Crustaceans (gills), Insects (tracheal system + spiracles). Exam point: 'Book lungs (patton jaisi lamellae) = Arachnids (makdi/scorpion)'.

qe: Bioluminescence exhibited by fireflies and deep-sea organisms results from the enzymatic oxidation of luciferin catalyzed by:
qh: जुगनू (Firefly) द्वारा रात में ठंडी रोशनी उत्पन्न करने की रासायनिक प्रक्रिया क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Jugnu (firefly) aur samudri gehri paani ke jeev andhere me roshni paida karte hain - ye kriya Bioluminescence kehlati hai; isme ek padarth 'luciferin' oxygen ke saath milta hai (oxidation) aur roshni paida karta hai, par ye reaction apne aap itna tez nahi hota - isliye ek enzyme chahiye jo isko tez kare (catalyse kare): Luciferase (isi liye naam). Baaki teen enzymes alag kaam karte hain: Melanin oxidase (rang), Catalase (H2O2 todna), Rhodopsin (aankh ka pigment - enzyme nahi). Exam point: 'Bioluminescence (roshni) = Luciferin ka oxidation, enzyme Luciferase se'.

qe: The state of metabolic dormancy entered by animals during hot, arid summer months to avoid desiccation is:
qh: गर्मियों में सूखे और अत्यधिक तापमान से बचने के लिए मेंढक और घोंघे द्वारा की जाने वाली 'ग्रीष्म निष्क्रियता' क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Kuch jeev garmi bhadke mahine (summer) me susth (dormant) ho jate hain, taaki unhe zyada garmi aur paani ki kami (desiccation - sukhna) na sehni pade - is 'garmi ki neend' ko Aestivation kehte hain (jaise mendhak/goh garmi me mitti me chale jate hain, snail apne khol me mud jate hain). Baaki teen bilkul alag hain: Migration (ek jagah se doosri jagah jana), Ecdysis (khaal utarna), Hibernation (sardi ki neend). Exam point: 'Garmi me susupti (summer sleep) = Aestivation; sardi me = Hibernation'.

qe: Which intravenous crystalloid infusion must be strictly avoided in diabetic patients due to rapid glycemic elevation?
qh: मधुमेह (डायबिटीज) के रोगियों को कौन सी ड्रिप बोतल नहीं दी जाती क्योंकि इसमें ग्लूकोज होता है?
e: Concept: Dextrose (glucose) IV solution - D5 ya D10 (5% ya 10% dextrose) - khaas kar sugar wale mareez (diabetes) ko nahi di jati kyunki ye seedha khoon me jaakar sugar tezi se badha deti hai (glycemic elevation) aur hyperglycemia/ketoacidosis ka khatra ban jata hai; sath hi ye paani ke saath mil-na bhi khaas nahi hoti. Baaki teen solutions sugar nahi rakhte: Normal Saline (0.9% NaCl - namak), Ringer's Lactate (electrolytes), Sterile water (kabhi seedha nahi diya jata). Exam point: 'Diabetes me nahi dena wala IV fluid = Dextrose (D5/D10, sugar wala)'.

qe: Why does the Indian Gooseberry (Amla) retain its high Vitamin C potency even after prolonged drying, processing, or boiling?
qh: आंवला को सुखाने या उबालने के बाद भी उसमें मौजूद विटामिन C आसानी से नष्ट क्यों नहीं होता?
o: It contains heat-stable ascorbic acid protected by endogenous protective tannins
It absorbs Vitamin C from air
Vitamin C converts into Vitamin D
e: Concept: Amla (Indian gooseberry) me Vitamin C bahut zyada hota hai, phir bhi ubaalne/sukhane par wahi Vitamin C zinda reh jata hai - kyunki amla me khaas khaas sammishran (tannins - gallic acid etc.) hote hain jo ascorbic acid ko oxidise hone se bacha dete hain (matlab wo 'heat-stable' ho jata hai); isliye amla ka pickle/murabba/amla powder me bhi vitamin C bacha rehta hai. Baaki teen galat hain (hawa se Vitamin C lena, Vitamin D me badalna, amla me acid ka na hona - amla khatta hai, acid se bharpur hai). Exam point: 'Amla ka vitamin C ubaalne par bhi bacha = tannins (polyphenols) ki suraksha se'.

qe: Which genetic bioengineered biofortified cereal grain produces elevated concentrations of provitamin A (beta-carotene)?
qh: विटामिन A की कमी और रतौंधी को दूर करने के लिए आनुवंशिक रूप से विकसित चावल की किस्म कौन सी है?
e: Concept: 'Golden Rice' ek GMO (genetically modified) chawal hai jisme daffodil aur bacteria ke genes daal kar endosperm me beta-carotene (Provitamin A) banaya gaya - isse chawal ka rang sunhara ho gaya (isliye 'Golden'); iska maqsad un deshon me maqsoosi vitamin-A ki kami (night blindness) kam karna hai jahan log sirf chawal khate hain. Baaki teen options alag hain: Basmati IR-64 (khushbu wala, GM nahi), Bt-Rice (keede ke liye Bt gene - par vitamin nahi), IR-8 (kai ka gandar wala). Exam point: 'Beta-carotene/provitamin A wala GM chawal = Golden Rice'.

qe: Industrial high-friction mechanical polishing of white rice kernels strips the outer aleurone bran layer, causing deficiency of:
qh: चावल को अत्यधिक पॉलिश करने से उसकी बाहरी परत से कौन सा विटामिन नष्ट हो जाता है जिससे बेरी-बेरी रोग होता है?
e: Concept: Chawal ko pees kar safed (polished) karne me uski upar wali parat (bran + aleurone) - jahan Vitamin B1 (Thiamine) sabse zyada hota hai - utar jati hai; isliye jo log sirf polished safed chawal khate hain unme Thiamine ki kami ho jati hai (ye bimari 'beriberi' kehlati hai - kamzori, pairon me jhunjhuni, dil ki samasya). Baaki teen vitamins is polishing ka kuch khaas nahi - aur ye paani wale/daal me hote hain: C, A, K. Exam point: 'Safed chawal polish = Vitamin B1 (Thiamine) ki kami (beriberi)'.

qe: Ripened yellow and orange fruits (Mango, Papaya, Carrots) are dense dietary precursors for the metabolic synthesis of:
qh: पके आम, पपीता और गाजर जैसे पीले-नारंगी फल मुख्य रूप से किस विटामिन के समृद्ध स्रोत हैं?
e: Concept: Peela-narangi rang wale fal-sabziyan (aam, papita, gaajar, kaddu) me beta-carotene (ek provitamin) bharpur hota hai; sharir isko chhote-tukdon me tod kar Vitamin A (retinol) banata hai - isliye jahan ghee/makhan/doodh se Vitamin A nahi milta, wahan ye 'plant source' kaam aata hai; aur yahi hai jo aankh (retina) aur chamdi aur immunity ke liye zaroori hai (khaas kar bachchon me). Baaki teen aise nahi bante: Vitamin D (dhoop se), B12 (sirf animal food), Vitamin C (khatte fal). Exam point: 'Peela-narangi fal-sabzi ka rang = beta-carotene, jo Vitamin A banta hai'.

qe: Which disaccharide carbohydrate composed of galactose and glucose monomers is specifically biosynthesized in mammalian milk?
qh: स्तनधारियों के दूध में पाई जाने वाली प्राकृतिक शर्करा कौन सी है?
e: Concept: Dudh ki khaas shakkar (milk sugar) Lactose hai - ye ek 'disaccharide' hai jo do simple shakkar (monosaccharides) se banti hai: Galactose + Glucose; ye sirf doodh (mammary gland me) me banti hai aur bachche ke sharir me ek enzyme (lactase) se toot kar energy deti hai - jo log ye enzyme dheere-dheere kho dete hain unhe 'lactose intolerance' (doodh se gas/dast) hoti hai. Baaki teen alag shakkar hain: Sucrose (cheeni - ganna), Fructose (fal), Maltose (gud). Exam point: 'Dudh ki shakkar = Lactose (Galactose + Glucose)'.

qe: What is the sweetest naturally occurring ketohexose monosaccharide found abundantly in ripening fruits and natural honey?
qh: फलों और शहद में पाई जाने वाली प्रकृति की सबसे मीठी प्राकृतिक शर्करा कौन सी है?
e: Concept: Duniya ki sabse mithas (sweetest) natural shakkar ek khaas 'ketohexose' monosaccharide hai - D-Fructose (fruit sugar) - jo pakke falaon aur shahad (honey) me bharpur hoti hai; ye cheeni (sucrose) se bhi zyada methi lagti hai (isliye 'fruit sugar' kehte hain). Baaki teen galat hain: D-Glucose (kam methi - blood sugar), Maltose aur Sucrose (ye disaccharides hain, monosaccharide nahi). Exam point: 'Sabse methi natural shakkar (fal/honey) = D-Fructose (fruit sugar)'.

qe: Which essential water-soluble micronutrient contains the coordination metal ion Cobalt (Co) at its corrin ring center?
qh: किस विटामिन के रासायनिक केंद्र में कोबाल्ट (Cobalt) धातु पाई जाती है जो लाल रक्त कोशिकाओं के निर्माण के लिए आवश्यक है?
e: Concept: Vitamin B12 (Cyanocobalamin) ek aisa vitamin hai jiske andar ek khaas heavy metal ion - Cobalt (Co) - ek 'corrin ring' (gol dhaanche) ke beech me baitha hota hai; yahi cobalt ise khaas banata hai (aur isi wajah se iska naam 'cobalamin' hai). Ye khoon ke RBC banane aur nerves ke liye zaroori hai; iski kami se 'pernicious anaemia' hota hai (aur ye sirf animal khaane/doodh me milta hai). Baaki teen B-vitamins me cobalt nahi hota (B1/B2/B6 me koi dhaatu ion nahi). Exam point: 'Cobalt ion sameta vitamin = Vitamin B12 (Cyanocobalamin)'.

qe: The prominent anterior division of the human forebrain that governs conscious thought, higher intellect, and memory is the:
qh: मानव मस्तिष्क का कौन सा सबसे बड़ा भाग ज्ञान, बुद्धि, विचार और स्मृति का केंद्र होता है?
e: Concept: Dimaag ka sabse bada aur cheshtamay hissa Cerebrum (Telencephalon) hai - iski bahari parat (cortex) me sochne, samajhne, bolne aur yaad rakhne ke center hote hain; yahi humari 'shakhsiyat' aur budhi (intellect) ka markaz hai (isliye insaan me ye hissa bahut bada hai). Baaki teen neeche ke hisse hain: Cerebellum (balance/precision movement), Hypothalamus (garmi-bhookh ke control), Medulla oblongata (dhadkan/saans). Exam point: 'Sochne samajhne/memory ka seat = Cerebrum (cerebral cortex)'.

qe: Which metencephalic structure located at the base of the brain regulates motor coordination, precision, posture, and balance?
qh: शारीरिक संतुलन, चाल और मांसपेशियों के समन्वय को बनाए रखने वाला मस्तिष्क का भाग कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Mathhe ke peeche aur sar ke base par ek chhota, jhuraadar (folded) dhaancha hota hai - Cerebellum - jo sharir ka balance, posture aur 'fine-tuned' harkat (precision) sambhalta hai: seedhi chadhna, cycle chalana, likhna - in sab ka hunar isi ki dein hai; isme kharabi par chalne me dagmagahat (ataxia) aur kaam me kampan (tremor) hota hai. Baaki teen alag hain: Thalamus (sensation relay), Pons Varolii (brainstem ka hissa - saans rhythm), Cerebrum (thinking). Exam point: 'Balance aur precision movement ka control = Cerebellum (chhota brain)'.

qe: The bark of which South American evergreen tree species serves as the historical pharmacological source of antimalarial Quinine?
qh: मलेरिया की प्रसिद्ध दवा 'कुनैन' (Quinine) किस पेड़ की छाल से प्राप्त की जाती है?
e: Concept: Quinine (malaria ki purani dawa) ko South America ke ek evergreen tree ki chhaal (bark) se nikala gaya - Cinchona (Cinchona calisaya/officinalis); ise 'Cinchona bark' ya 'Jesuit's bark' kehte hain aur yahi se quinine mila jisse saikdon saal malaria ka ilaaj hota raha (aaj bhi severe malaria me use hota hai, aur tonic water ki kadwahat isi ki hai). Baaki teen paudhe alag dawaaon ke liye mashhoor hain: Azadirachta indica (neem), Eucalyptus (tel), Taxus baccata (cancer ki dawa taxol). Exam point: 'Quinine ka source tree = Cinchona (chhaal/bark se)'.

qe: The specialized biological discipline dedicated to the study, classification, and pathology of true Fungi is termed:
qh: कवकों (Fungi) के विस्तृत वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Fungi (kavak/mushroom) ka adhyayan ek khaas shastr hai - Mycology - jisme unki pehchaan, vargikaran, vikas aur bimariyan (jaise kavak, dukoo infection, crop diseases) sab padha jata hai; ye bahut kaam ka hai kyunki kuch fungi khaane/antibiotic (penicillin) ke liye ahem hain aur kuch bahut nuksaandeh (rust, smut). Baaki teen alag shastr hain: Virology (virus), Bacteriology (bacteria), Phycology/Algology (shaiwal). Exam point: 'Fungi ka adhyayan = Mycology'.

qe: The aromatic culinary 'Curry Leaf' plant (Murraya koenigii) belongs taxonomically to which plant family?
qh: दाल और सब्जियों में इस्तेमाल होने वाला 'कढ़ी पत्ता' (Curry Leaf) किस वानस्पतिक परिवार से संबंधित है?
e: Concept: Curry leaf (kari patta - Murraya koenigii) ka paudha Citrus family (Rutaceae) ka hissa hai - isi family me neembu, santra, mausambi, kamala aate hain; pehchaan: iske patteon khushbu-daar tel (essential oil) hota hai aur phool/fal bhi citrus family jaise hote hain; isliye vaigyanik taur par ye rutaceae hai (Bharat ke south me iske patte roz ka khaana hain). Baaki teen families galat hain: Fabaceae (daal wali/matara, moong), Solanaceae (aalu, tamatar, mirchi), Lamiaceae (pudina, tulsi). Exam point: 'Curry leaf (Murraya koenigii) ki family = Rutaceae (Citrus/nimbu family)'.
